content.title: Who Are the Apache? – Dr. Roy Casagranda | Museum of the Future: Lessons from the Past
content.text: Who Are the Apache? is Dr. Roy's fifth lecture for the Museum of the Future's Lessons from the Past (2025). This collaboration between the Museum of the Future and Dr. Roy aims to explore 10 topics ranging from the life of the father of modern medicine to examples of great leadership to the birth of the Most Serene Republic of Venice. 🌍 Learn more: https://museumofthefuture.ae ~~~ Explore the untold history of the Apache people in this in-depth lecture by Dr. Roy Casagranda. From their unique matrilineal society and spiritual beliefs to their fierce resistance against Spanish, Mexican, and U.S. colonization, this episode uncovers the brutal legacy of genocide, forced relocation, and cultural survival. Discover legendary figures like Geronimo and Mangas Coloradas, and examine the role of General George Crook—first a fierce adversary, then an unlikely ally in the fight for Native American rights. Through historical context and modern relevance, this episode offers a powerful lens into one of the most resilient Indigenous nations in North America. ~~~ Apache crown dancers - • Apache crown dancers ~~~ 🔉 Dr. Roy Casagranda Podcast 🔉 Podcast Spotify ▶ https://open.spotify.com/show/6aebF9B...
